title: Magickal Movie Night! Nightmare Before Christmas!
seo_title: Nightmare Before Christmas Movie Night in Joplin, MO
description: This is a cozy, spooky movie night showing The Nightmare Before Christmas, with popcorn, snacks, and drinks, plus tarot readings on request, a best merch contest, and a 50/50 raffle. It is for all ages, and guests are welcome to bring a friend or date. It takes place Saturday, November 28, 2026 at 7:00 PM at 502 S Brownell Ave in Joplin, MO; RSVP is recommended because the space holds only 30 people.
